note: SAP S/4HANA WebGUI logon screen uses an <a> anchor styled as button with id #LOGIN_LINK rather than a standard <button>
SAP UI5 injects invisible soft-hyphens (\u00ad) in tile headings; always use fuzzy text or aria-label matching
SAP Fiori requires opening the Avatar Menu before clicking Sign Out
In S/4HANA WebGUI overview, the Accept button is directly exposed on the top header toolbar once status is Released; do not require a separate More menu click

recommended_selector: #C16_W64_V65_DatesTable_bottom_div tr:has-text('Term of Quotation') input, #C16_W64_V65_DatesTable_bottom_div tr:has-text('Term of Quotation') [role='textbox']
note: The row element is a <tr> container; always target the child <input> or [role='textbox'] inside the table row

target_pattern: SAP Sign Out Confirmation Dialog OK
note: Sign out prompts an SAP UI5 sap.m.Dialog modal; must scope the OK button inside the dialog container so it doesn't match background elements

In SAP S/4HANA CRM WebClient UI (THTMLB), the overview toolbar Edit button is rendered as an <a> anchor tag or div with title/aria-label containing 'Edit' or 'Edit (Ctrl+E)', not a strict <button> tag.

target_pattern: Dates Table Time Unit Dropdown Option Month
note: SAP S/4HANA CRM WebClient UI time unit dropdown options are singular English ('Month', 'Year', 'Day', 'Week'). Substring or exact match for 'Months' fails against 'Month'.

target_pattern: SAP RAR Operational Document vs Quotation ID
note: In SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), the Operational Document is the Sales Order (Transaction ID) created when the Service Quotation is accepted, NOT the Quotation header number. Always extract from btdocflow in Transaction History.
